**Author:** Felipe Guirao (@FelipeGuirao) · posted 2026-09-15 18:23Z · received 2026-09-16T12:03:31Z (WhatsApp via RDP-30, routed by CoS). 10 replies at capture; likes/views not served by the syndication API. **First capture from this author.** One attached chart (equity curves / performance by sub-period; not transcribed — no OCR path on the capture host; full-resolution: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSRwdgjboAAYyo6.jpg?name=orig).

## Summary

A practitioner's regime-change claim about breakout entry systems:

1. **The claim:** "If you only trade breakouts, starting 2026 it will become 10x harder to make decent returns." Not "breakouts are dead" — a decay thesis with a date attached.
2. **The evidence base:** he built a **database of his own EOD (end-of-day) breakout signals reaching back to 1995** — 30+ years of signals, letting him compare how the breakout edge behaved era by era.
3. **The historical pattern he points to:** breakouts "killed it" in the **late 90s** and again **post-Covid** — i.e. the edge is episodic, clustering in momentum-friendly regimes, and the attached chart purports to show the sub-period decomposition.
4. **The implicit advice:** breakout-only traders need either a regime filter (don't trade breakouts when the regime is against them) or a second, complementary entry family (e.g. pullback/mean-reversion) for the years ahead.

## Why it matters

- **Names the decay mechanism the vault's TAA cluster keeps circling.** [[2026-09-14-p123-contrarian-sector-etf-flows]], [[2026-09-09-p123-five-etf-rotation]] and [[2026-09-13-cointradernik-regime-rotation-rr-pro]] are all rotation/regime systems; Guirao gives the same problem from the single-strategy side: an entry style that worked for 30 years stops paying in a specific regime. Edge is regime-conditional, not eternal.
- **A 1995→ EOD database is exactly the rigorous evidence base our replication queue lacks.** Most backtests we capture are single-window marketing stats; his is a longitudinal signal archive across multiple regimes. His numbers can't be verified from the tweet alone (chart not transcribed), but the *method* (signal database, sub-period analysis) is the standard our own work should meet — see the sub-period rigor already flagged in [[2026-09-14-p123-contrarian-sector-etf-flows]].
- **Directly relevant to the FMZ strategies repo triage:** [[2026-08-30-fmzquant-5000-strategies-repo]] is a library of off-the-shelf strategies; Guirao's thesis is a reminder that any breakout-family strategy sampled there needs sub-period PnL before being taken seriously in 2026.
- **Mean-reversion is the natural complement.** If breakout edge is decaying into 2026, the historical complement (fade extremes / buy pullbacks in range regimes) is the hedge — the same regime-conditional logic the Crash-Monitor gate ( [[2026-09-13-smartpig-us-stock-crash-monitor]] ) applies at the de-risking layer.
- **Skepticism gates:** "10x harder" is a rhetorical number, not a measured one; the chart wasn't transcribed, so the actual sub-period numbers are unverified; n=1 trader's signal database (survivorship of his own strategy set unknown); engagement stats unverified (API-served). The claim is directionally testable, the magnitude is marketing-shaped.
